We propose a study that uses optimal portfolio strategy as a bridge: first, review how exponential utility and optimal trading are each currently treated through optimal portfolio strategy; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
